decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk line fits the firm's office and conference strategy and growing workplace demand, so it stays.
A chair family is close to the core offer, has its own web page and supports both residential and contract business.
Floor cushions made from carpets reuse rug materials at low cost, though as a niche accessory they carry some risk of being pruned.
The sofa is close to the core business, but its low web presence suggests weaker emphasis and a higher chance of removal.
A high standing table fits the flexible workplace and lounge solutions the firm targets and is cheap to keep in the range.
Although distant from the core offer, the rug collection is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, so management will keep supporting it.
